prompt: A company logo is a regular octagon. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
hint: A line of symmetry is a fold line: the two halves must match exactly.

hints.text: A line of symmetry is a fold line: the two halves must match exactly.
There are two kinds of folds here — through opposite vertices, and through the midpoints of opposite sides. Count each kind.
$4$ vertex-to-vertex lines plus $4$ side-to-side lines gives $8$ lines of symmetry.

explanation: A regular $n$-gon has exactly $n$ lines of symmetry, so a regular octagon has $8$.
Four of them connect opposite vertices; the other four connect the midpoints of opposite sides.
It also has $8$-fold rotational symmetry, turning onto itself every $45^\circ$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Fold a stop sign
steps: Imagine folding a stop sign corner-to-corner: it matches, and there are $4$ pairs of opposite corners.
Now fold it edge-midpoint to edge-midpoint: it matches again, and there are $4$ pairs of opposite edges. Total $8$.
